The grassy side yard in Photos 2 and 3 looks roomy, about 10 ft or more between the walls, but the wall stretch next to the meter (tree stumps, a window) is cut off. The side in Photo 14 has a gas meter and a car parked on the grass, so it is likely too close to the gas meter and a drivable surface.
